text: OVERDOSAGE A 17 month old infant inadvertently received 1,600 mg of intravenous pentamidine isethionate which was followed by renal and hepatic function impairment, hypotension and cardiopulmonary arrest. Treatment included cardiopulmonary resuscitation, epinephrine, atropine and intubation. In addition, a four hour course of charcoal hemoperfusion was accompanied by reduction of pentamidine serum concentration and stabilization of the patient's condition. The patient recovered from these adverse events, but later died due to an unknown cause. 1
